{% extends "!layout.html" %} {#- A docset that is published in one version only, see DOCSET_VERSIONS in _utils/docsets.py, is something the theme has no notion of: it builds the version dropdown from the publication-wide versions.json, and links the docset switcher to the docset directory of the version being read. The script below narrows the dropdown of such a docset to its own version, and points the switcher entry of such a docset at that version from wherever it is read. It goes after super(), which emits the ncs.js of the theme, because that is what defines window.NCS, and ahead of the document-ready handler of ncs.js, which is what fills the dropdown. -#} {%- block scripts %} {{ super() }} {%- if pinned_docsets %} {%- endif %} {%- endblock %}
